resources.string:
Finding a hymn
• Home tab: enter a hymn number, then tap Da Ben, Bu Chong, Xin Shi, Xin Song, Er Ge, Qing Nian or English to show lyrics and score.
• Content search: type words and tap Search; searching for 他 also finds 祂 automatically.
• Recent hymns appear below on the Home tab: tap one to open it, swipe it sideways or tap its delete button to remove it from the list.
• Contents tab: choose a hymnal, then browse by Category, Stroke, PinYin or the English–Chinese index.

Lyrics page
• The button row at the top has buttons for score tint, A- and A+ (text size), Share, Media (show or hide the player) and Next.
• The More menu (three dots) holds Reading settings, show/hide player, online English lyrics, Help and Home.
• Swipe left or right for the previous or next hymn.
• Turn the phone sideways for a larger page; the player starts hidden.

Playing media
• Choose Media, teaching, singing or accompaniment above the player, then tap Play to start, tap again to pause, and again to resume.
• Tick Auto-next on the player to play the following hymns continuously; untick it to stop.

Settings tab
• Theme and language, home text size and colour, Reading settings, Media Configuration, Check for updates, Android Permission Settings, Help and About.
• Media Configuration: add your own audio or video links for each hymn, and export or import them to share with other devices. Media files you download yourself go under Download/hymnal/.

Updates
• Settings → Check for updates looks for a new version. After it downloads, tap the notification to install.
